column1: # Solana Bunker film sound manifest: one row per audition file. Same format as clan-world apps/android/tools/audio/cues.tsv.
# Built by master.py on dev-mac (encoding is banned on do-box). Columns are tab-separated, 11 per row.
# out      output stem = <cue>-<n>-<short-desc>; the file is audition/<out>.mp3 (libmp3lame 128 kbps, 48 kHz stereo).
# cue      cue id (news-open, news-close, slot-slam, stamp-thump, projector-click, glass-shatter, cash-register,
# cand     candidate letter within the cue. Kept stable across rounds; a retired letter is not reused.
# ship     0 = audition candidate (all rows for now).
# class    sting (HP 60 Hz, LP 16 kHz) | sfx (HP 60 Hz, LP 14 kHz).
# target   event loudness in LUFS (ebur128 I, 1 s of silence padded so the 400 ms gate sees short sounds). Liam: sound
#          effects not too loud, never jarring, so every cue is -20.
# maxlen   seconds kept after the leading silence is cut.
# ceiling  sample-peak limit before encoding, dBFS. -4 leaves room for the mp3 encoder to stay at or under -3 dBTP.
# layers   '+'-separated layers mixed together; a layer is segments SOURCE@start-end joined by '~' (0.25 s crossfade),
#          then |key=value options delay (ms), gain (dB), af (ffmpeg filters). SOURCE is fs:<freesound id> or
#          k:<pack>/<file stem> (pack: casino, impact, rpg). See SOURCES.tsv. fs: ids are HQ previews (stand-ins).
# post     ffmpeg filters after the mix ("-": none). Macros: @SHELF (-4 dB high shelf at 7 kHz, -2 dB at 3.5 kHz),
# --- 1 news-open: broadcast opening sting for the cut into the news desk (2-4 s)
# --- 2 news-close: urgent SPECIAL REPORT sting (1-3 s)
# --- 3 slot-slam: metal shutter / slot slam (0.3-0.8 s)
# --- 4 stamp-thump: rubber stamp / wax seal thump
# --- 8 whoosh: soft swoosh for cards / sheets sliding in
